title: WHO BENEFITS FROM TRADE WARS?
abstract: We are grateful for insightful comments and suggestions from Lucian Bebchuk, Alma Cohen, Ramona Dagostino (NFA discussant), Sudipto Dasgupta, Andrew Ellul, Mara Faccio, Mariassunta Giannetti, Nandini Gupta (EFA discussant), Bing Han, Jarrad Harford, Michael Hertzel, Ron Kaniel, Víctor Martínez de Albéniz, Ronald Masulis, Lin Peng, Kamalini Ramdas, Ariel Rava, David Simchi-Levi, Dennis Sosyura (AFA discussant), Liyan Yang, and Dexin Zhou (CICF discussant) and participants at seminars at the 2025 American Finance Association Annual Meeting (AFA 2025), the 2023 China International Conference in Finance (CICF 2023), the 35th Northern Finance Association Annual Meeting (NFA 2023), the 50th European Finance Association Annual Meeting (EFA 2023), Harvard Law School, Georgetown University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Tulane University, IESE Business School, Peking University HSBC Business School, London Business School, Syracuse University, the Chinese University of Hong Kong, the National University of Singapore, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore Management University, and The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. This paper was previously circulated under the title “The Golden Revolving Door.” Corresponding author: Professor Lauren Cohen. The views expressed herein are those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect the views of the National Bureau of Economic Research.
